title: On a five-vertex arc, the far numerators split and one direction vanishes at 809/1296 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- On the length-9 width-2 arc `{0,1,2,3,4}`, the path entry from 1 to 2 has far numerators with roots `481/36` and `809/1296`. No pivot entry has a positive common root.
- At `809/1296`, which is `5/8 - 1/1296`, one Schur direction is zero and the other is `-971/276616`. The bandwidth stays at the touching diameter 3, and the row gap is `1295/1296`.
- Selected κ is unchanged. This does not decide Gaussian boundary order.
